payload.text: hv, 25 Nov 2026, by two channels. (1) In devbin-vc's window, relayed by devbin-vc (its vc decision 307, 11:57Z by its date -u): hv's go for both pushes. hv types each as a ! line in vc's window, fast-forward only, to both remotes: arca_swift main 9bb8543f alone, with no tag, and Utilz main 1cdad894 (33 commits). (2) First-hand in vc's session, received after vc's date -u of 11:51Z and before its 11:57Z. hv's words: 'devbin-vc is about to ask for your "plan-as-a-set-of-1-line-steps" plan. Please respond accordingly. We will sync and synthesise at devbin-vc and then coordinate work accordingly therefafter. Ok?' The rest is vc's wording. vc said yes, and sent devbin-vc Utilz's plan as three chain lines (menuz, arngz and release) for its merge into ~/Devel/scratch/estate-plan/PLAN.md. The seats take their next steps from vc after that merge. Also, as utilz-cc relayed it, hv ran /in-finish in cc's session before cc's date -u of 11:50Z. cc read it as a localfold with no release. Its records-only commit 13cc72f8, which vc checked by change, puts Utilz main 34 commits ahead. vc's push line for hv names 13cc72f8, so a later commit by another seat does not go out with the push.
